headline: Sizing up after losses is hurting your performance.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The cost of sizing up after a loss was ₹1,05,732. In the 96 after‑loss trades the median entry size was ₹12,562 compared with ₹6,578 otherwise, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28%, while other trades had a win rate of 39%.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is worth watching as it may be affecting your results.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size after a loss for the next review period.
